clue.text: Making out it's infectious

definitions.meaning: making out a faint sound is hearing or grasping it, as you might pick up a tune
an infectious illness is one you can pick up from someone else

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: grasping or perceiving something, and of a disease, transmissible from person to person.

clue.text: Arrive the day after, missing a most amusing event

indicators.note: the shortened day comes after the word for arrive

parts.note: to come is to arrive

indicators.note: the letter A is missing, so it is taken out of the day

parts.note: taken as day
the letter A

explanation.surface: Someone turns up a day late and misses a hilarious occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: A comedy is a play or show meant to amuse, a highly entertaining occasion.

clue.text: For a time the little creature makes itself at home

definitions.note: a verb phrase describing the one who lives in a rented home

parts.note: ten o'clock is a time
an ant is a tiny insect

explanation.surface: A small insect moves in for a while and settles comfortably.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant settles in and occupies a dwelling as a lodger or leaseholder.

clue.text: Many years later, they're captured

indicators.note: the word for years comes later, after the word for many

parts.note: a host is a great number, many
ages means many years

explanation.surface: Years afterwards, a group of people are taken prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostages are people seized and held as security by captors.

clue.text: Want Ned to have a key

indicators.note: the name is to have, that is hold, the letter inside it

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Ned asks for a key to be cut for him.
explanation.definitionFit: Want and need are synonyms for lacking something.

clue.text: With the assistance of fellows, getting round girl

indicators.note: the word for fellows gets round, that is surrounds, the word for help

parts.note: fellows are men
assistance is aid

explanation.surface: A girl manages something only with help from the men around her.
explanation.definitionFit: A maiden is an old-fashioned word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: Saw a crowd round it and is prepared for

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the little word
to crowd things is to jostle them together, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone saw a crowd gather round something and got ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crowd' rearranges SAWA into AWAS, which goes round IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To await something is to be ready and expecting it.

clue.text: Having hesitated, did intern the soldier

indicators.note: to intern is to confine, so the word did confines the other letters

parts.note: taken as written
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British army's corps of sappers

explanation.surface: After some hesitation, someone locked up the soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Dithered means wavered, unable to decide, which is to have hesitated.

clue.text: In tennis playing, that is old

definitions.note: an adjective, while the answer is a noun for an age range

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters being thrown about in play

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone at a tennis match is described as elderly.
explanation.walkthrough: TENNIS and IE together are rearranged by 'playing'.
explanation.definitionFit: A person in their nineties is aged between ninety and ninety-nine, so very elderly.

clue.text: Give assistance to the gentleman hemmed in

indicators.note: something hemmed in is enclosed, so the little word is enclosed by the title for a gentleman

parts.note: a gentleman is addressed as Mister
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gentleman is boxed in and someone must help him out.
explanation.definitionFit: To minister to someone is to attend to their needs and help them.

clue.text: With cunning, the fellows captured the animal

indicators.note: the fellows have captured, so hold inside them, the word for cunning

parts.note: fellows are men
art can mean craft or cunning, as in artful

explanation.surface: Some men use their wits to trap a wild animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The marten is a weasel-like animal of the woods, hunted for its fur.

clue.text: Having a liking for the role "Ali the Wanderer"

parts.note: an actor's role is a part

indicators.note: a wanderer roams about, so the name's letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor is fond of playing Ali the Wanderer.
explanation.definitionFit: Partial to something means fond of it, having a liking for it.

clue.text: No, "Ireland" is misspelled, R's missing

indicators.note: a misspelled word has its letters in the wrong order, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the named letter is missing, so it is taken out of the country's name

parts.note: the letter R named in the clue

explanation.surface: Someone protests that the word Ireland has been written wrongly, without its R.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking R out of IRELAND leaves IELAND, which 'is misspelled' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A no is a refusal or contradiction, which is what a denial is.

clue.text: Later, beating the rug outside, be too rough

indicators.note: the word for rug sits outside the rearranged letters

parts.note: a mat is a small rug

indicators.note: beating something knocks it about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A housekeeper decides to beat the carpet outdoors later, perhaps too vigorously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beating' looks like a carpet being beaten, but it signals the rearranging of LATER to ALTRE.
explanation.definitionFit: To maltreat is to treat cruelly or roughly, which is handling someone too harshly.

clue.text: Convince that you will pay up

definitions.meaning: to persuade fully, so that doubts are removed
to settle a debt in full

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to assure someone completely, and to discharge an obligation such as a debt.

clue.text: Leaves holding the record in the game

indicators.note: the name of the game holds, that is contains, the short record

parts.note: darts is a pub game of throwing at a board
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Someone walks out while still holding the record score in the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaves and departs are synonyms for going away.

clue.text: The crest is said to come originally from China

indicators.note: a word spoken rather than written, so the sound counts, not the spelling

parts.note: the crest of a mountain is its peak

explanation.surface: A heraldic crest is claimed to have its origins in China.
explanation.walkthrough: A peke is a Pekingese, a small dog breed first bred in China; the definition describes it rather than naming it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pekingese toy dog was bred at the imperial court in Peking, so it came from China.

clue.text: Well, I took the agent back to have a drink

indicators.note: back says the run of words is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: fit means well, in good health
a rep is a representative or agent

explanation.surface: Feeling better, someone took an agent back for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the run to PERITIF; 'to have a' reads as adding the letter A in front, so 'took' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink taken before a meal.

clue.text: They're not good when it comes to extraction

definitions.text: They're not good when it comes to extraction

parts.words: They're not good when it comes to extraction
parts.note: extraction means ancestry or breeding, not dentistry; these animals lack a pure pedigree

explanation.definitionFit: Mongrels are dogs of mixed or unknown breed, so their lineage is poor.

clue.text: Said ours, without exception, will be late

parts.note: all means every one, without exception

indicators.note: words that are said are heard, so something sounding like the word is wanted

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like HOURS

explanation.surface: Someone says that everything of ours will arrive late.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying up till all hours means very late at night.

clue.text: No great shakes as a river, either

parts.note: the Po is the longest river in Italy
either and or go together, as in either this or that

explanation.surface: Something is rated mediocre, whether as a river or as anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No great shakes' is an idiom for unimpressive or mediocre.
explanation.definitionFit: Poor means of low quality, which is what no great shakes says informally.

clue.text: After all, it is part of the plane, chum

parts.note: an aircraft's tail fin is part of a plane
a chum is a friend or ally

explanation.surface: Someone concludes, after all, that a friend is part of an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Finally and after all both mean at last, eventually.

clue.text: The oarsman depicted with a movement of brush

definitions.meaning: the rower nearest the stern who sets the pace for the crew
a single sweep of a paintbrush

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the pacesetting rower in a boat, and one mark made by a brush.

clue.text: Going back myself to port for a refit for a while

indicators.note: a ship's refit rebuilds it, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order
going back says the word is read in reverse

parts.note: me means myself

explanation.surface: I am returning to port for a while so the ship can be refitted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a refit' rearranges PORT into PROT; 'Going back' turns ME into EM.
explanation.definitionFit: Pro tem, short for the Latin pro tempore, means for the time being.

clue.text: Bad tot went first

parts.note: to tot up is to add
to lead is to go first, so led means went first

explanation.surface: A naughty toddler pushed in at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An addled egg has gone bad, rotten.

clue.text: "Send an order for," you say, "straightaway"

indicators.note: words that you say aloud are heard, not seen, so a phrase that sounds the same is wanted

parts.note: to write off for goods is to send away for them by letter

explanation.surface: A customer is told to send an order immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Right off is an informal phrase meaning at once, immediately.

clue.text: Or dropped round and stayed

indicators.note: the word for dropped goes round, enclosing, the little word

parts.note: to shed is to drop, as a tree sheds leaves
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone either left or stayed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shore up a wall is to prop it, and a stay is a prop or support.

clue.text: Standing to embrace a blushing sweetheart

indicators.note: the reversed colour embraces, holding inside, the letter
in a down clue, standing upright means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a blushing face is red

explanation.surface: A suitor stands holding a blushing sweetheart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standing' turns RED into DER, and A goes inside it. The printed clue lacks its letter count.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear is a term of endearment for a loved one, a sweetheart.

clue.text: Being attached to, that is, don't rattle about

indicators.note: something rattling about is shaken loose, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A warning not to let something rattle around loose.
explanation.walkthrough: IE and DONT together are rearranged by 'rattle about'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tied on is fastened or attached to something else.

clue.text: Only later is prepared to ring with a denial

indicators.note: the rearranged letters form a ring around the word for only
letters that are prepared are made ready in a new arrangement

parts.note: but can mean only, as in but a child

explanation.surface: Someone only gets ready to phone back later to deny something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is prepared' rearranges LATER into RETAL, which rings BUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a contradiction of a claim, which is a kind of denial.

clue.text: Hurry, he's hungry!

definitions.meaning: a cry urging greater speed, quicker
someone going without food on purpose is hungry, one who fasts

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the comparative of fast, urging speed, and a person who abstains from eating.

clue.text: Thought it had quietly been continued

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
something resumed has been carried on again after a pause

explanation.surface: Someone thought the matter had quietly carried on.
explanation.definitionFit: To presume is to suppose or take for granted, so presumed means supposed.
